# Introduction

We here analyze data from an RNASeq experiment (MB044, Gabriela Vallejo Flores, Simeng Liu, Hilmar Berger ) performed on organoids (Wnt- for last days) from gastric clones derived from IM and phenotypically normal epithelial biopsies.

We assume that among the 51 clones from 3 patients there should be some with a more IM phenotype and others with a more normal gastric phenotype.

The goal of the analysis is to determine which of the clones shows IM or normal phenotypes in order to select those to be used for subsequent deeper and more comprehensive sequencing studies. 

```{r}
IMPORT_DATA = FALSE

if(IMPORT_DATA) {
  suppressMessages(library(org.Hs.eg.db))
  suppressMessages(library(AnnotationDbi))

  count_data_hisat = fread("../featureCount/_counts.txt")
  sample_cols = grepl(".bam$", colnames(count_data_hisat), perl=T)

  count_mat = as.matrix(count_data_hisat[, sample_cols, with=F])
  rownames(count_mat) = count_data_hisat$Geneid
  snames = gsub("_sorted\\.bam", "", unlist(sapply(strsplit(colnames(count_mat), "/"), function(x) x[length(x)] )) )
  colnames(count_mat) = snames
  
  gene_anno = as.data.frame(count_data_hisat[, !sample_cols, with=F])
  
  
  # This was run in R 3.6.1
  # library(biomaRt)
  #ensembl90 <- useEnsembl(biomart = 'ENSEMBL_MART_ENSEMBL', dataset = 'hsapiens_gene_ensembl', version = 90)
  #gg = getBM(attributes = c("entrezgene","hgnc_symbol","ensembl_gene_id", "description"), filter = c("chromosome_name", "ensembl_gene_id") , 
  #         values=list(chromosome_name = c(as.character(1:22), "X","Y"), ensembl_gene_id = d$Geneid), mart=ensembl90 )
  #fwrite(gg, file="Ensembl_v90_human_gene_annotation.txt", sep="\t", quote=F)

  ens_anno_orig = fread("Ensembl_v90_human_gene_annotation.txt")
  setnames(ens_anno_orig, colnames(ens_anno_orig), c("EntrezID","GeneSymbol", "Geneid", "GeneName"))
  # as usuaö there are 1:n relationships to GeneSymbol, EntrezID, GeneName - fix those to 1:1
  collapse_fun <- function(x) paste(unique(x[!is.na(x)]), collapse="," )
  ens_anno_agg = ens_anno_orig[, .(EntrezID=collapse_fun(EntrezID), GeneSymbol=collapse_fun(GeneSymbol), GeneName=collapse_fun(GeneName)), by = "Geneid" ]
  
  gene_anno = merge(gene_anno, ens_anno_agg, by="Geneid", all.x=T, sort=F)
  rownames(gene_anno) = gene_anno$Geneid
  
  # FIXME consider reading total counts (including unmapped/unassigned) for normalization
  fpkm_mat = sweep(sweep(count_mat, 2, apply(count_mat, 2, sum)/1e6, "/"), 1, gene_anno[rownames(count_mat), ]$Length/1e3, "/")
  
  save(count_mat, fpkm_mat, gene_anno, file="HISAT_featureCount_hg38_gene_expression.Rdata")
} else {
  load("HISAT_featureCount_hg38_gene_expression.Rdata")
}
```

## UMAP

```{r}
coldata <- exp_design[colnames(count_mat),]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sampleID
ed = exp_design
#ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Group == "Control", ifelse(ed$Site=="small intestinal", "SI", "Stomach control"), ed$Group)
#ed$Condition = factor(ed$Condition, levels=c("Stomach control","Non-IM", "IM","SI"))

dds = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(count_mat[included_genes, ], colData=coldata, design = ~ Condition)
norm_counts = as.data.frame(assay(varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind=FALSE)))
colnames(norm_counts) = gsub("Row.names", "Geneid", colnames(norm_counts))

library(umap)

sel_samples = ed$sampleID
nc_mat_selected = as.matrix(norm_counts[,sel_samples])
rownames(nc_mat_selected) = norm_counts$GeneSymbol

col_anno = ed[, c("Condition","Patient")]

breaks_new=c(-10,-5,-3,seq(-2,2,by=4/94),3,5,10)

means = apply(nc_mat_selected , 1, mean, na.rm=T)
mads = apply(nc_mat_selected, 1, mad, na.rm=T)
sel_genes = means > 5 & mads > quantile(mads, 0.95) # this still leaves us with ~1700 genes

input_mat = t(nc_mat_selected[sel_genes,])

set.seed(1243)
rr = umap(input_mat)

library(leiden)
# library(vegan)
# dd = dist(rr$layout)
# st = spantree(as.matrix(dd))
# part = leiden(st)

library(igraph)
dd = dist(rr$layout)
g  <- graph.adjacency(as.matrix(dd), weighted=TRUE)
g_mst <- mst(g)
A <- as_adjacency_matrix(g_mst)

part = leiden(A, resolution_parameter = 0.1)
exp_design[rownames(A),"partition"] = part
```

# Differential Expression Analysis

We perform the following comparisons: 

  - IM vs. non-IM in all patients
  - all IM clones vs. normal stomach antrum
  - for each patient separately: IM clones vs. normal stomach antrum
  - for each patient separately: IM clones vs. non-IM clones
  - for each patient separately: non-IM clones vs. normal stomach antrum
  - HGAT-26-A1, HGAT-29-A1 vs. all other HGAT samples [NAntr1_vs_NAntr2]
  - SI vs. HGAT26-A1,29-A1
  - Colon vs. HGAT26-A1,29-A1

```{r}
coldata <- exp_design[colnames(count_mat),]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sampleID
ddsHisatGE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~ Condition)
```

```{r, dge_analysis, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ed = exp_design

included_genes = (apply(count_mat,1,max) > 1) # & (substr(rownames(count_mat),1,1)!="_")

# All patients - IM vs. non-IM clones
############################################

dds_selected = ddsHisatGE[included_genes, included_samples]
dds_selected$Condition <- factor(dds_selected$Condition, levels=c("IM","Non-IM"))
dds_selected <- DESeq(dds_selected, fitType="local")

res <- results(dds_selected, contrast=c("Condition","IM","Non-IM"))

excluded_genes = names(included_genes[!included_genes])
cols_in_res_table = colnames(all_results[[1]])
empty_cols = do.call(cbind, Map(function(x) rep(NA, length(excluded_genes)), cols_in_res_table ))
excluded_gene_tab = data.frame(row.names = excluded_genes, empty_cols )

for (n in names(all_results)) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  resOrdered <- data.frame(tmp[order(tmp$pvalue),])
  resOrdered = rbind(resOrdered, excluded_gene_tab)
  resOrdered$padj = ifelse(is.na(resOrdered$padj),1,resOrdered$padj)
  res_annotated = as.data.frame(merge(resOrdered, gene_anno[,c("Geneid","GeneSymbol","EntrezID","GeneName")], by.x=0, by.y="Geneid", sort=F))
  #res_annotated = as.data.frame(merge(resOrdered, gene_anno[,c("Geneid","GeneName")], by.x=0, by.y="Geneid", sort=F))
  res_annotated = merge(res_annotated, count_mat, by.x="Row.names",by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
  all_results[[n]] = res_annotated
}
```

### Volcano plots

For each comparison, the distribution of the fold change (on a log2 scale) and adjusted p-value (on reverse logarithmical scale) is shown in a volcano plot. The red line denotes the FDR cutoff of 0.05. 

```{r, DE_volcano, results="hide", fig.width=16,fig.height = 6 }
all_target_conditions = names(all_results)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
all_GSA_results = list()
for (tc in all_target_conditions) {
  r = all_results[[tc]]
  plot(r$log2FoldChange, -log10(r$padj),xlab="log2 Fold Change",ylab="-log10(adj. p-val)", ylim=c(0,max(2,max(-log10(r$padj),na.rm=T))))
  title(main=tc, sub=paste("(",nrow(subset(r, padj < 0.05))," signif. DE genes)",sep="") )
  abline(h=-log10(0.05),col="red")
  
}
```



```{r, DE_combined, results="hide"}
all_DE_results_tmp = list()
for (tc in all_target_conditions) {
  tmp = all_results[[tc]]
  tmp$condition = tc
  all_DE_results_tmp[[tc]] = tmp
}
all_DE_results_ts = do.call(rbind, all_DE_results_tmp)
all_DE_results_ts$DE_class = ifelse(all_DE_results_ts$padj>0.05, "n.s.", ifelse(all_DE_results_ts$log2FoldChange > 0,"Up","Down"))
#agg_fun = function(x) paste(unique(x),collapse=";")
agg_fun = function(x) ifelse("Down" %in% x, "Down",ifelse("Up" %in% x, "Up","n.s."))
all_DE_results_sw = reshape2::dcast(all_DE_results_ts, GeneSymbol ~ condition, value.var="DE_class", fun.aggregate=agg_fun)
```
